Cova's seamless tech ecosystem gives retailers access to the best tools available to run their business.

product.name: Cova Cannabis POS
product.description: A point-of-sale system designed specifically for cannabis retailers to manage sales, compliance, and inventory.

product.name: Cova Inventory Management
product.description: A system for tracking and managing cannabis product inventory to ensure compliance and optimize stock levels.

product.name: Cova Compliance Software
product.description: Automated compliance tools integrated with cannabis POS to ensure adherence to state and provincial regulations.

product.name: Cova eComm
product.description: An eCommerce solution integrated with Cova POS for cannabis retailers to sell products online with real-time inventory synchronization.

product.name: Cova Pay
product.description: A payment processing solution integrated with Cova POS, designed for cannabis and CBD retailers to handle transactions securely and compliantly.

product.name: Cova CBD POS System
product.description: A point-of-sale system specifically for CBD and hemp retailers, supporting compliance and integrated payment processing.
